# Week of Welcome 2026

VinUniversity's Week of Welcome (WOW) 2026 is an orientation program for new students, scheduled from September 11 to September 20, 2026. The program is part of OASIS and is intended to help new students understand university culture, resources, student services, academic support, safety, and campus life.

## Main activities
- Move-in activities and community events during the first two days.
- Student services and holistic development introduction, advisor meetings, and future-planning activities.
- Sessions on values, identity, regulations, staying safe online and offline, and academic support.
- College-specific programming for CBM, CAS, CECS, and CHS.
- Academic integrity and AI in learning, plus a fire-fighting and prevention drill.
- An Ocean Park tour for international students and a student club experience.

## Student help
The page states that attendance is mandatory for new students. The campus medical clinic is at room I119 on the first floor of Building I. The Student Affairs Office is at room I116, Building I. Students can use the VinUni Mobile app and official channels for campus news, events, student services, and benefits.
